name: One Night, One Forever
overview: After a painful breakup, 24-year-old waitress Lila Carter has a one-night stand with billionaire Ethan Grayson and soon discovers she is pregnant. Afraid of her controlling mother’s reaction, she keeps the pregnancy a secret until mounting pressure forces her to tell Ethan. Their marriage begins as a reluctant arrangement, complicated by Ethan’s ongoing relationship with influencer Sophia Blake. As Lila struggles to adapt to her new life, Ethan gradually realizes she is not after his wealth but a strong and caring woman devoted to their unborn child. What starts as an unwanted union slowly grows into a journey of love, trust, and redemption.
